$comment: Copy to ~/.mcp.json and remove the servers you do not need.
Every value that could be a credential is written as ${VAR}. Claude Code expands these from
your environment at launch. Never paste a literal key into this file — a real key in
~/.mcp.json is one 'share your screen' away from being someone else's key.
Set the variables in ~/.config/agent-kit/env.sh (scripts/install.sh creates it, chmod 600)
and source that file from your shell profile.
Servers requiring no key at all are listed first. Start there. Add the rest only when a task
actually needs them — every enabled server costs context in every session.
